newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Aug industrial price index rises 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Aug industrial price index rises 0.4 pct.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Friday issued the following economic indicators for August.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
The IPPI reflects the prices producers receive as goods leave their plants.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would rise 0.2 percent in August from July.
